name: BeeHotel Happening Today
description: Generates a daily hotel report (arrivals, departures, in-progress stays, rooms to clean) and emails it on cron.
project_description: BeeHotel Happening Today generates a daily operational report for a property and can email it automatically on cron. The report covers today's arrivals, departures, in-progress reservations, guests who arrived yesterday (first night passed), rooms to clean, and guests leaving tomorrow. A settings form configures the send time, recipients, subject and format, and offers a test send. A page at /admin/beehotel/happening-today shows the report on demand.
